post.description: Admin: gives a component to a player, regardless of the self-assign rules.

delete.description: Archives the component. It disappears from the catalog but stays readable for players who own it.

post.description: Creates a player with the starter kit: the beginner needle, 2 threads ×3 and 2 coatings ×3.
A player adds a component to their own inventory. Allowed only when self-assign is on and the component is player-assignable.

get.description: Realm summaries, newest first. Filter by player or by the map they were opened from.
format=svg|prompt (one area; area defaults to the first) or json|md (the whole realm).

post.description: Resolves the slots without changing anything: map auto-fill, random fill, mismatch and danger, and anything that would stop the ritual.

Performs the ritual in one transaction. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: repeating a request with the same key returns the first result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of performing it again. 400: invalid selection. 409: components not owned, or spent by a concurrent ritual (reload and retry). 422: the key was already used for a different request, or the realm can't be generated.
